projects.title: Multimodal AI for Early Disease Detection
projects.summary: An AI-driven healthcare system leveraging multiple data types including medical images, EHRs, genetics, and symptoms. Applied deep learning and data fusion techniques to improve early-stage disease detection accuracy.
projects.description: A comprehensive healthcare solution that combines multiple data modalities to enable early disease detection with higher accuracy.
projects.impact: Built a multimodal foundation for early disease detection across imaging and clinical text workflows.

projects.title: Real-Time Sign Language Interpreter
projects.summary: Built a multi-modal AI perception system for real-time sign language interpretation. Streamed results to a JavaScript frontend with dynamic UI overlays and modular architecture.
projects.description: Real-time AI system that interprets sign language using computer vision and streams results to an interactive web interface.
projects.impact: Delivered a real-time interpretation flow with responsive frontend feedback and modular processing.

projects.title: Expense Tracker Web App
projects.summary: Built a responsive and interactive web application to manage income, expenses, and monthly budgets. Implemented transaction management with category tags, timestamps, and visual charts for spending distribution.
projects.description: Full-featured expense management application with real-time tracking and visual analytics.
projects.impact: Simplified expense tracking with visual summaries and clear transaction management.

projects.title: Ola Electric Clone
projects.summary: Created a full-stack web application inspired by Ola Electric's platform. Simulated features such as vehicle listings, test ride bookings, service scheduling, and charging station locators with an admin panel.
projects.description: Full-stack e-mobility platform with comprehensive admin and user interfaces.
projects.impact: Demonstrated full-stack capability across listings, bookings, scheduling, and admin workflows.
